notes:
I couldn't write any notes on Job 35 this time, because I wasn't able to read a single source page.

My first attempt tried to open seven pages at once: Enduring Word, the Bible Hub pages for Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and Barnes, Precept Austin and NET Bible. That went over the tool's usage limit before any page loaded. When I tried again with just the Enduring Word page, the tool said I had no calls left for this turn.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge, so I haven't written anything. I have no source or URL to back up any note, whether on the usual reading of each verse, on where Protestant traditions differ, or on modern, Catholic and Orthodox views.

If you send the request again, I'll get the pages one or two at a time so I stay within the limit. I'll start with Enduring Word and the Bible Hub commentaries (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Barnes) for the verse-by-verse reading. After that I'll go to Precept Austin and the NET Bible notes. Last, I'll look at the tradition-specific sites for vv. 2–3, 6–8 and 10–14.
